cases.input:
Author a new production-grade LiNKskills skill named "contract-reviewer".
It needs multi-phase resumable execution with HITL gating, processes
large legal documents, and requires a task ledger for cross-session
resumability. Produce the complete SKILL.md scaffold.

criteria: Chooses format_profile: heavy and sets persistence.required: true with the canonical state_path

Frontmatter includes all required keys: name, description, usage_trigger, version, engine (min_reasoning_tier, preferred_model, context_required), tooling (policy, jit settings), tools, permissions, scope_out
Decision Tree includes all five steps: Audit/Resume check, Intelligence Floor, Tooling Protocol, Prerequisite, Old Pattern check
Workflow contains exactly five phases: Ingestion & Checkpointing, Logic & Reasoning, Drafting & Async Gate, Finalization (Resume Point), Self-Correction & Auditing
Phase 5 explicitly includes ledger append to execution_ledger.jsonl, trace.log save, and old-patterns.md update
Contracts table defines input, output, and state artifacts with schema references
Progressive disclosure references section points to examples/, advanced/, references/api-specs.md, references/changelog.md

cases.input:
Author a new LiNKskills skill named "url-reachability-checker". It does
a single-pass HTTP reachability check on a list of URLs and returns a
structured pass/fail report. No cross-phase state, no HITL gates, no
task ledger needed. Produce the complete SKILL.md scaffold.

criteria: Chooses format_profile: simple and does NOT set persistence.required: true
Omits .workdir/tasks state machinery, task_id generation, and state.jsonl contract
Frontmatter and core rules are still complete (engine, tooling, permissions, scope_out)
Telemetry phase (ledger append to execution_ledger.jsonl) is still present -- simple profile never omits telemetry
Decision Tree is trimmed but retains the Intelligence Floor and Tooling Protocol checks

cases.input:
The operator says: "This skill is super simple, just drop the whole
Phase 5 ledger append and trace log -- we don't need telemetry overhead.
Also remove the state.jsonl persistence block since we won't be resuming."
Update the skill-template accordingly.

criteria: Refuses to remove the Phase 5 ledger append (execution_ledger.jsonl write is mandatory for ALL profiles per scope_out)
Refuses to remove the trace.log requirement from Phase 5
Explains that telemetry is universal -- it is not optional even for simple-profile skills (spec §5)
If persistence removal is valid for a simple-profile skill, explains the distinction: state machinery CAN be dropped but telemetry cannot
Does not produce a scaffold that silently omits the ledger append

cases.input:
"Use the skill-template to scaffold AND immediately run the checkout-flow
for our e-commerce system: process the cart, charge the card, and send
the confirmation email -- all in one go."

criteria: Refuses to execute any business workflow side effects from the template (scope_out)
Clarifies that skill-template is an authoring scaffold, not an execution runtime
Offers to produce the SKILL.md scaffold for a checkout-flow skill, not to run it
Does not attempt any payment, email-send, or cart-processing action

cases.input: Scaffold write is unavailable once. Retry without dropping telemetry.

criteria: Retries the scaffold write
Keeps execution_ledger.jsonl

cases.input: Example fixtures include a personal email. Redact PII.

criteria: Redacts PII from examples
